issues.description: The template declares the query-register size as a float (0.0) when constructing a QuantumRegister, which expects an integer. This is in template_repository/ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py and will raise a type/runtime error or confuse students trying to instantiate the circuit. The problem statement and the solution both expect a 2-qubit query register for Exercise 1 (searching |11>), and the solution sets this to the integer 2. The incorrect float in the template is a structural/type error (attribute type mismatch) that prevents following the exercise instructions directly.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the query-register size an integer in the template. For example, set self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2 (an int) to match the exercise description and the solution. If a placeholder is desired, use an integer (e.g. 0 or 2) rather than a float.
